title: Near-critical Voronoi universality conditional on Cardy limits
exact_target: Assuming critical Poisson–Voronoi crossing probabilities obey Cardy’s formula in all admissible quads, do the entire near-critical crossing ensembles, scaled by their own inverse expected pivotal counts, have quenched laws converging in probability to the same continuum law as independently normalized triangular site percolation? The conditional law averages coloring marks while keeping the Poisson geometry fixed.
